name: 70043 · Chalmette, LA
findings: ZIP 70043 (Chalmette) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70043 (Chalmette) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70043 (Chalmette) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
